purpose: Add reproducible PEMS03/04/07/08 validation evidence for classical baselines, Mamba-1/2, and the MambaTS-inspired patch/variable-scan baseline, with paired AutoCon representation-learning arms.
research_question: Does the MambaTS patch/variable-scan inductive bias close the high-dimensional traffic gap observed for the shared Mamba-2 forecaster, and does the AutoCon objective change validation behavior under the same data, normalization, and budget?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only pilot. Test windows remain withheld; no row is a publication-level ranking or non-inferiority result.
claim_boundary: Use paired seed deltas for screening and failure analysis. Do not claim generalization, statistical significance, graph-aware forecasting, or end-to-end speed from this plan.

required_before_launch: review the PEMS array hash and feature-axis contract
verify the active mamba environment and CUDA Mamba-1/Mamba-2 kernels
confirm all models use the same train/validation split, MeanStd normalization, and optimizer budget
confirm AutoCon representations use only observed windows and training-derived objective statistics
freeze this plan before any training launch and keep test metrics withheld during selection

prelaunch_gates: review the PEMS array hash and feature-axis contract
verify the active mamba environment and CUDA Mamba-1/Mamba-2 kernels
confirm all models use the same train/validation split, MeanStd normalization, and optimizer budget
confirm AutoCon representations use only observed windows and training-derived objective statistics
freeze this plan before any training launch and keep test metrics withheld during selection

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Retain source hashes, plan/config hashes, manifests, validation trajectories, relation telemetry, and resource records. Test metrics remain withheld.

phases.name: pems_plain_h12
phases.purpose: Matched short-horizon plain baselines: linear, patch, periodic, Mamba-1, Mamba-2, and MambaTS-inspired scan.

phases.name: pems_autocon_h12
phases.purpose: Paired AutoCon representation-learning arms for Mamba-1, Mamba-2, and MambaTS under the same PEMS windows.

phases.name: pems_long_h96
phases.purpose: Long-horizon stress test for the strongest short-list baselines and both MambaTS objective variants.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas within each dataset and horizon. Time windows and channels are not independent replicates; no graph topology is used. Plain versus AutoCon comparisons are objective ablations, not independent model families.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This pilot can identify promising PEMS baselines and failure modes for a later confirmation matrix, but cannot establish a final ranking, non-inferiority, generalization, or speed claim.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation-only and dry-run are the only permitted actions.
If any PEMS hash, feature index, source snapshot, config hash, or phase artifact changes, stop and regenerate the plan rather than merging rows.
Do not use test metrics to select MambaTS patch geometry, AutoCon lambda, or the final model.
If an AutoCon arm has missing representation or objective telemetry, treat that cell as a failed contract rather than imputing a value.
A favorable PEMS validation pattern is exploratory and requires fresh seeds, longer horizons, test release, matched resource measurement, and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.
